visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for 'Start Interview' or 'Upload Resume' cards. Animate a gradient border.
visual_enhancers.bento_grid: Use for Dashboard Analytics. Mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 cards.
visual_enhancers.score_circle: Use Recharts PieChart or simple SVG for ATS Score. Don't use generic bars.

marketing.hero: Left-aligned strong typography (Oswald). Right side: 3D or layered UI mockup (glassmorphism). Background: Subtle grid pattern.
marketing.features: Bento Grid layout. Alternating text/image blocks. High contrast icons.
marketing.testimonials: Horizontal scroll (Marquee) or Grid of clean cards with avatars.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (fixed). Top header (sticky, glass). Main content area (scrollable).
dashboard.grid: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Charts span 4-8 cols. Stats span 2-4 cols.
dashboard.widgets: Card-based widgets. Clean headers. Minimal chart axes.

interview_room.layout: Central focus: AI Avatar/Waveform. Bottom: Control Bar (Mic, Cam, End). Right/Bottom-Right: Live Transcript (collapsible).
interview_room.vibe: Cinematic, Distraction-free. Focus on the voice.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistency is key.
icons.recommendation: Use Lucide for UI. Use Phosphor (if available) for marketing.

hero_main.alt: Professional confident woman ready for interview

guidelines.interview_waveform: Looping bars based on audio amplitude.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is APCA compliant. Dark text on light backgrounds must be slate-700 or darker.
accessibility.focus: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.screen_readers: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Semantic HTML structure.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind Colors: Update tailwind.config.js with the specified palette (Electric Indigo & Deep Obsidian).
2. Font Setup: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css or index.html immediately.
3. Component Audit: Customize Shadcn components in /components/ui to match the 'Performance Pro' rounded-md and border styles.
4. Layout Implementation: Build the Dashboard layout using the Sidebar/Header pattern.
5. Live Session: Implement the 'Interview Room' with a mandatory dark theme toggle or forced dark mode context.
6. Charts: Use Recharts for the Analytics dashboard. Style them to match the theme (no default colors).
7. Testing: Add data-testid to all buttons and inputs as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
